senses.gloss: दिधक्षा दिधक्षा, i. e. दिधक्ष, desider. of दह्, + अ, f. The desire to consume by fire, MBh. 1, 8363.
दिधक्षु दिधक्षु, i. e. दिधक्ष, desider. of दह्, + उ, adj. Desirous to consume by fire, MBh. 1, 8090; to destroy, Bhāg. P. 5, 26, 35.

दिधिषु दिधिषु, i. e. दिधिष, old desider. of धा, + उ,
 I. m. A husband, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 34.
 II. f. षू, A widow married to the brother of her deceased husband, Man. 3, 173.
 --Comp.

दीधिति दीधिति, i. e. दीधी + ति, f.
 1. A ray of light, a sun or moonbeam, MBh. 3, 188; Prab. 94, 6.
 2. Light, Pañc. i. d. 369; Mārk. P. 18, 19.
 3. Splendour (?), Bhartṛ. 2, 22.
 --Comp.
दीधी दीधी (akin to दी), ii. 2, Ātm. To shine (ved.).
